hooks.command: sh -c 'f="$1"; case "$f" in api/*.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/api" && ruff format "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$f" && ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$f" ;; esac' _ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
hooks.name: ruff-format-on-edit

hooks.command: sh -c 'f="$1"; case "$f" in code/src/*.ts|code/src/*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/code" && npx vitest related "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$f" --run ;; esac' _ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
hooks.name: vitest-related-on-edit
